builds.name: Twin Fang ceiling
builds.summary: Poisoned Twin Fang combines level base + .2 AP and 120 + .45 AP bonus; poisoned hit has .65 AP. Six offensive slots trade movement and defensive utility for this isolated damage objective; Cassiopeia can purchase boots after her 26.1 passive rework.
builds.goal: Poisoned Twin Fang combines level base + .2 AP and 120 + .45 AP bonus; poisoned hit has .65 AP. Six offensive slots trade movement and defensive utility for this isolated damage objective; Cassiopeia can purchase boots after her 26.1 passive rework.
builds.hypothesis:
Cassiopeia launches deadly fangs, dealing [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=50, perLevel=4.1176, changes=[]) + (0.2) × AP] magic damage. If the enemy is Poisoned, they take an additional [20 / 45 / 70 / 95 / 120 + (0.45) × AP] magic damage and Cassiopeia restores [(0.1 / 0.115 / 0.13 / 0.145 / 0.16) × AP] Health, reduced to [((0.1 / 0.115 / 0.13 / 0.145 / 0.16) × AP) × (0.25)] Health against lane minions and small monsters.

If this kills the target, Cassiopeia restores [45 / 45 / 45 / 45 / 45] Mana.
Deathcap multiplies AP; Void Staff and Shadowflame reduce effective MR on magic packets, with Shadowflame low-health amplification tested. Zhonya/Banshee are high AP stat slots; Riftmaker is fully ramped before scoring. Mana variants use earned Seraph for mana-derived AP, read live; burn variants use Liandry ramp and Blackfire one-target AP buff, with proc damage separate. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers.
